items.caption: This received seal-script form places 雨 above 令, matching the traditional analysis of 雨 as the rain element and 令 as the sound element. Another Shuowen reading names 霝 as the sound element.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 零 on white, with 雨 above 令.
items.selection_reason: It shows the form and component arrangement discussed in the traditional analysis; the image is a modern redraw rather than an ancient inscription.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw of a seal-script form transmitted in the Shuowen tradition, not an excavated inscription. No verified early inscription form of 零 is established here.
The Shuowen accounts differ between 令聲 and 霝聲; the reason for this difference is unresolved.
